text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You sure went all out for training today!
And Trainer too—you both
really packed a
punch!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I think Trainer wants the same
thing I
do—to see just how high I
can soar.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure the upcoming Takarazuka
Kinen also has something to do
with it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove is running in it too, right?!
Finally, a head-to-head battle with your
rival! As always,
I'll be there to cheer you
on!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Suzuka, let me give you another
massage today. We
wouldn't want any sore
muscles slowing you down!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Suzuka, your leg muscles are so tight! Like, mega tight! I really need to loosen you up!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I run,
I feel like I can
still go farther...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When I'm running, I feel like there's
someone there, pushing me to run
even
faster, to go even farther...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because you, our trainer, and
everyone else on Team Sirius
has been so
supportive.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, and we'll keep being supportive!
All you have to do is show us
more of your
amazing running!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And to show you I mean it, I'll massage
your legs till they turn to jelly!
I'll show
you what milking cows does for your hand
muscles!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: C-cows?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after her jaw-dropping performance
at the Kinko Sho, Silence
Suzuka surprises
us all by continuing to improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eager to help her give a spectacular
performance at the Takarazuka
Kinen, I
head over to the training track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (H-huh? Wh-when did it get so dark?)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (H-huh? Wh-when did it get so dark?)
Heave-ho, heave-ho.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: (A-am I being carried? What's going on?!)

Welcome, my dear trainer, to my
laboratory.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: L-laboratory?! Who are you?!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: L-laboratory?! Who are you?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I am Agnes Tachyon, and I brought you
here to have a word with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A wry smile adorns the Umamusume's
expression. Looking down at her
feet, I see
a burlap sack. Did she just kidnap me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A wry smile adorns the Umamusume's
expression. Looking down at her
feet, I see
a burlap sack. Did she just kidnap me?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Creep" is going a little too far,
don't you
think? I may have been a
tad rough, but I
brought you here with good intent.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You see, I want to talk. Specifically,
I want
to talk about your trainee,
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's all?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... By the way, have you ever thought
about how enigmatic we
Umamusume are?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Our anatomy is practically identical to
humans, yet our physical
prowess far
exceeds that of man.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We Umamusume are full of such
mysteries... and well, solving those

mysteries is the focus of my research.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
...What does that have to do with my
trainee?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
...What does that have to do with my
trainee?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Imagine, running a race accelerating the
whole time. Even I have to
admit... your
aspirations intrigue me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If she can master that running style of
hers,
it could take us
Umamusume to the next
level—nay, a whole new world!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I want to know what training methods you're implementing as you explore this uncharted territory. That is why I brought you here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Interesting. Are you sure you're not
doing anything out of the
ordinary?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just plain ol' training and rest. I
don't want to overwork her,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If your training is not the cause of such
super-Uma speed, then perhaps Suzuka's
innate physical capabilities are just that

spectacular...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just as likely to be something
psychological. Perhaps it's
manifesting
physically as a perceived increase in
strength.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Something psychological? What are you
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Surely you've heard it before. We
Umamusume are said to run
carrying the
hopes and dreams of others.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You've seen the Three Goddesses statue in
the plaza, yes? The legend there also
describes Umamusume as beings who carry
the wills
of others.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As a researcher,
I tend to dismiss such talk
as romanticism, but... I am
also an
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes when I run, I can feel it. I can
feel someone pushing me
forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be referring to the fans of
racing. One of the many reasons
Umamusume race
is to meet the expectations of their
adoring fans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my apologies... We've drifted from our
original conversation. Unfortunately,
hearing about your training regimen has
spoiled my
plans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's more... I have to admit, I have
concerns for your future. Grave
concerns.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You and Suzuka seek to boldly go where
no racer has gone before. The ideal you
search for may even lie beyond an
Umamusume's
capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But when you cross that threshold, her
legs...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon trails off and she averts
her
eyes. I take a deep breath
before
continuing with her apparent conclusion.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You don't think her body can handle it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You don't think her body can handle it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I don't know. Whatever I say would be nothing more than speculation. I'm not even sure Umamusume have limits.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After all, we are full of mysteries. I
apologize if my words alarm you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In any case,
I am looking forward to seeing
what kind of running you and Suzuka
create... May it serve as a shining beacon
for generations to come.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's gooo! I'm off to do some ramp
training!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I believe that's next on my schedule too,
followed by running the
straightaways,
correct?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As always, Silence Suzuka is diligent at
practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her regimen is nothing special, and
physically, she seems like any
other
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet that running of hers is unlike
anything
I've seen before... Just
what will happen if
we continue down this path?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You and Suzuka seek to boldly go where
no racer has gone before. The ideal you
search for may even lie beyond an
Umamusume's
capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! Ramp training, and then
straightaways.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right! Ramp training, and then
straightaways.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All right, then I'll get started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her running style is something other
Umamusume only dream about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nobody can run like that. Or at least,
nobody but Suzuka ever has.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(If we keep this up, she's going to go
beyond what should be
physically
possible.)

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
(If we keep this up, she's going to go
beyond what should be
physically
possible.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As much as I don't want to think about it,
the thought of an
impending disaster
continues to plague my mind.
